We’re one of the country’s largest energy companies, with a vision of powering a future where people use energy more efficiently and it’s safer and delivered more reliably than ever. We’re also deeply connected to the communities we serve, with more than 13,000 employees working together to support our customers and make a difference every day.

Here, you’ll have the stability and exciting opportunities that come with being a Fortune 500 company — along with a supportive, friendly work environment where your contributions are valued.

We offer a flexible work environment designed to balance employee needs with collaboration and operational excellence. Roles fall into two categories:

• Onsite: Employees work onsite daily.

• Hybrid: A blend of remote and onsite work, with at least three onsite days per week required.

As an employee, if you are regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week, you will have access to a wide range of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being: medical, dental, vision, paternal leave and family leave programs, behavioral health programs, 401(k) with company match, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, and generous paid time off.

More than 13,000 people already call PSEG their work home, taking pride in providing safe, reliable service to millions of customers. If you’re looking for a place where you can build a meaningful career and help power and support our communities, we’d love to welcome you to the team.

Job Summary

PSEG Long Island's Customer Intelligence team is seeking a highly analytical and innovative professional to transform customer and operational data into actionable insights that drive strategic decision-making and elevate customer experiences.

This role will leverage advanced analytics, statistical modeling, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data visualization techniques to understand customer behavior, identify trends, predict outcomes, and optimize customer interactions. The successful candidate will play a key role in translating complex data into meaningful business insights, collaborating across functions, and advancing the organization's use of modern analytics and AI technologies to amplify the Voice of the Customer throughout the company.

Job Responsibilities

• Design & develop automated dashboards and create meaningful data visualizations that enable business leaders to track customer experience metrics, provide reporting solutions and support deep dive analytics.

• Work cross functionally to pull together information from internal and external sources to develop, launch, and track the performance of key initiatives aimed at improving customer experience and supporting higher J.D. Power performance.

• Support end-to-end Voice of the Customer (VoC) programs, customer segmentation, propensity modeling, and predictive analytics initiatives.

• Ensure data quality, governance, and adherence to analytical best practices.

• Proactively suggest advanced analytics solutions, analyze structured (quantitative) and unstructured (text, voice recordings) data, develop & deploy machine learning models and text analytics solutions.

• Establish external and internal relationships to share best practices in data science, stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies

Job Specific Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree preferably in Data Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience performing data analytics or data science

• Experience designing and developing dashboards using Tableau and/or Power BI.

• Expertise in data wrangling, including integrating multiple data sources into cohesive data assets and aggregating large datasets for specific purposes.

• Proficiency with data preparation and workflow automation tools such as Alteryx or Tableau Prep.

• Experience with Python, SQL or R and machine learning methodologies.

• Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, Word, PowerPoint

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

• Passion for customer insights and a commitment to improving customer experience through data-driven decision-making.

• Must have excellent verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment

• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team

Desired:

• Familiarity with J.D. Power and/or other electric utility voice of the customer resources

• Experience with Customer research methodology, tools and techniques

Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living [our values](https://ouraring.com/about-us) and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst — Hardware to join our Data Analytics team in North America. You will be the analytics lead on the data that measures the success and quality of ŌURA's hardware portfolio—how rings perform, sell, activate, and hold up for our members over their lifecycle.This is the data behind hardware portfolio performance—revenue, units sold, sell-through, activation, COGS, margin—and the quality signals, including warranty, RMA/returns, and defect rates, that show up in board and public reporting. This role will ensure that ŌURA continues to be a scalable consumer-hardware business while migrating to a unified data platform on Databricks. You will make sure the numbers that leadership and external auditors steer by—units sold, sell-through, activation rate, warranty rate, and defect/quality rate—are defined once, computed correctly, are traceable end-to-end from source systems to the executive dashboard, and audit-ready. You will partner with Hardware Engineering, Quality, Product, Finance, and Data Engineering to build the governed hardware data foundation.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Hardware KPI Ownership**
* Own the analytics layer for the hardware portfolio scorecard—partner with Hardware Engineering, Product, Quality, and Finance to define, document, and deliver the KPIs that show up in board and external reporting (including but not limited to activation rate, warranty rate, return/RMA rate, and defect/quality rate).
* Establish each hardware KPI as a governed, audit-grade data product—locked definitions, single owner, data build tool (dbt) tests, full lineage from source systems, formal sign-off, and a documented change-management process.
* Build and own the hardware data products.
* Be the analytics representative in external audit cycles—produce documentation, walk auditors through lineage, and ensure controls and traceability are reflected in how hardware portfolio and quality metrics are produced.
* **Hardware Quality & Portfolio Performance Analytics**
* Partner closely with Hardware Engineering and Firmware teams on product quality data—defect rates, failure modes, warranty claims, RMA root cause, and field reliability by product generation, SKU, and manufacturing batch.
* Deliver hardware portfolio performance analytics—sell-through, activation, and retention by product generation and SKU—that give Hardware leadership a single trusted view of what's working and what isn't.
* Drive adoption of self-service reporting by Hardware Engineering, Quality, and Product partners using a variety of analytics tools and creating clear documentation to reduce one-off reporting and free up analyst time for analysis.
* **Platform Migration & Data Engineering**
* Migrate hardware portfolio and quality reporting from legacy stacks (Snowflake + Tableau + Sheets) to our Databricks-based platform, with dbt-modeled metrics, Unity Catalog lineage, and Databricks SQL / Genie as the executive-facing surface.
* Coordinate with source-system owners across manufacturing, quality systems, and e-commerce (NetSuite, contract-manufacturer feeds, Zuora) and the Data Engineering team to ensure clean ingestion, correct dimensional modeling, and clear lineage from factory output through to sell-through, activation, and quality events.
* Resolve systems data quality issues to ensure that reporting is trustworthy end to end.
* Build and maintain the Hardware domain's data products in Databricks, mentoring analysts on dimensional modeling, dbt practices, and the Golden Path for publishing governed metrics for reporting and for MCP/agentic AI consumption.
* **Tooling & Innovation**
* Continuously evaluate emerging tools (Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, AI-assisted SQL/modeling via Cursor and Claude Code, semantic-layer technologies) to improve productivity and accuracy in hardware portfolio and quality reporting.

We have offices in San Francisco, San Diego and Los Angeles for those who prefer hybrid or office settings. ŌURA employees in other major cities (like Boston and New York) occasionally gather informally at local co-working locations.

**What you'll bring:**

* 7+ years in analytics, business intelligence, or a related data-focused role, with at least 3+ years specifically supporting Hardware, Product Quality, or Manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience building executive-level reporting for a physical-product business that is trusted by leadership and survives external scrutiny (Board, auditors, investors).
* Deep working knowledge of hardware data domains: BOM and component costing, warranty and RMA/returns, defect and quality rates, manufacturing yield, and how transactional systems (ERP, contract-manufacturer feeds, hardware use platforms) flow into reported numbers.
* Expert in SQL with experience writing complex queries for operational and financial data extraction, reconciliation, and modeling.
* Expertise in dimensional modeling for hardware and quality reporting (conformed dimensions across SKU, product generation, channel, geo; slowly-changing dimensions for product and cost hierarchies; period-over-period comparisons).
* Experience with dbt—including tests, documentation, exposures, and contracts.
* Experience with Databricks strongly preferred (Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Lakeflow, Genie); deep Snowflake experience acceptable with willingness to migrate.
* Experience with modern BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Databricks SQL Dashboards, Power BI) and a clear point of view on when each is the right fit.
* Track record of working alongside external auditors (PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG) and building documentation that withstands audit review.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills—able to brief a hardware or finance leader on a number, then explain to an analyst how the data behind it works.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, highly collaborative global work environment that spans engineering, quality, and offices across time zones.

**Nice to have:**

* **What Makes You Stand Out**• Familiarity with adjacent tooling and sources: AWS, GitHub, NetSuite/ERP, Fivetran, Python, semantic layers, quality management systems (QMS), and contract-manufacturer (CM) data integrations.
* Experience standing up a hardware data contract and product/SKU dimension (dim\_hardware) from scratch in a high-growth consumer hardware company.
* Experience building governed KPI programs through a formal external audit (e.g., PwC, Big 4), including COGS, quality, and units-sold reconciliation.
* Expertise in data visualization theory—you understand how to choose the right chart for the right message and why exec dashboards fail when they don't.
* As a company we are focused on improving the way we live our lives. From the people who use our product to the team behind it, we work to empower every person to own their inner potential.

### **Benefits**

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

* Competitive salary and equity packages
* Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
* An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
* 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
* Paid sick leave and parental leave

While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. Job Description

About the Role
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. You'll build high-performing teams in ambiguous environments, make hard calls under pressure, and carry the weight of decisions that matter. If you lead with clarity, build with heart, and thrive in challenge this is where you'll make your mark.

Global Delivery S&P sets the strategy, plans and performance standards for Uber's Delivery business across Restaurants, Retail and Direct. Within Data Products & Analytics, the Data Reporting & Tooling team builds the analytical products that Regional Ops and S&P teams use to monitor performance, investigate changes and take action. Its portfolio spans the Global Delivery Scorecard, centralized Ops dashboards, reporting automation, alerts and AI-enabled self-service tools.

As the Manager, Data Analyst, you will lead the design, delivery and adoption of these tools. You will turn recurring business questions into intuitive, scalable products that help teams pressure-test assumptions, diagnose performance and make better decisions. You will own the tooling roadmap from discovery through launch and ongoing improvement, partnering with Data Infrastructure & Governance, which owns shared metric definitions, uMetric and the Data Mart.
What You’ll Do
Act as a technical lead, including coaching analysts to own products from user discovery and design through build, testing, launch and upkeep, with clear accountability for quality and business impact
Set the analytical products roadmap: understand the decisions Ops and S&P teams need to make, translate them into product requirements and prioritize reusable tools over repeated one-off reporting. Balance strategic builds, maintenance and urgent business needs
Own the Global Delivery Scorecard and business review reporting experience, including automated MBR/GMBR views, intuitive drill-downs and performance diagnostics. Reduce manual preparation and help users move from monitoring results to framing the questions that matter
Build and evolve shared Ops dashboards, diagnostic tools and actionable alerts. Assess Retail tools such as Cancellations, Funnel and market scorecards for Delivery-wide use; agree what to expand, consolidate, retain, transfer or retire
Lead product design and hands-on prototyping, choosing the right tools for the audience and workflow. Set a high bar for usability, visualization and analytical storytelling, then iterate with users before scaling successful solutions

Develop AI-enabled analytical workflows with the AI & Automation team, including the S&P Knowledge Brain, Knowledge Library and Business Review repository. Use AI agents to accelerate research, build, testing and documentation; evaluate analytical answers, citations and calculations before release
Own rollout, adoption and product health with Regional S&P, Ops and GSS. Agree acceptance criteria for regional migrations, document and train users, establish support and maintenance owners, and measure usage, time saved, reporting retired and alerts acted on

Experience designing intuitive dashboards, scorecards, diagnostic tools or recurring business review experiences using BI tools such as Tableau or Grafana, or custom analytical applications

Experience using AI coding or analysis agents to build and improve tools, and evaluating AI-generated answers for accuracy, traceability and usefulness

Born of a simple gesture in 1976 , L’Occitane en Provence reveals the living power of flora, where the light of the sun meets the richness of the earth.
With advanced expertise, we turn these natural treasures into sensorial, efficient experiences, as sustainable as possible and profoundly inspired by Haute Provencal nature.
Our culture is built through everyday moments, how we behave, make decisions and show up for each other.
With Trust as our foundation, Curiosity as our compass, Excellence as our standard, we create lasting Impact for the people around us and our planet. Job Summary
The Customer Data Analyst owns and strengthens the technical foundation supporting customer analytics across L’OCCITANE North America. The role combines hands-on data development, automation and customer analytics to deliver reliable datasets, workflows, integrations and reporting solutions that improve commercial performance and the customer experience.

This is more than a reporting role. The successful candidate will use strong technical judgment to create simple, reliable and maintainable solutions; enable business users to answer recurring questions through trusted self-service tools; and apply emerging automation and AI capabilities where they create practical business value.
The role partners closely with CRM, E-commerce, Retail, Customer Care and other teams. It requires curiosity, independent problem solving and proactive communication of progress, risks, dependencies and business impact. The right person translates technical work into clear language and turns new ideas into useful, scalable capabilities without introducing unnecessary complexity. Key Responsibilities
Customer & Commercial Analytics

• Conduct deeper analysis when questions require advanced data manipulation, specialized customer-data knowledge or cross-channel interpretation, and provide teams with actionable customer intelligence.

• Translate complex findings into clear business implications, recommendations and actions, not simply reports.

• Identify meaningful trends, anomalies and opportunities while keeping the focus on decisions and measurable business value.

• Support customer segmentation, CRM targeting, lifecycle analysis and customer-behavior analysis across channels and markets.

• Validate analytical outputs for accuracy, consistency and appropriate use of customer information.

Data Development, Automation & Reliability

• Build, maintain and improve customer-data pipelines, transformations and automated workflows using SQL, Python and appropriate workflow tools.

• Develop reusable, well-structured datasets in Snowflake or comparable cloud data platforms for analytics, CRM and reporting use cases.

• Integrate internal and external data through APIs, JSON, SFTP, scheduled files and other appropriate methods.

• Monitor production processes and proactively resolve failures, data-quality issues and upstream or downstream dependencies.

• Design for maintainability by reusing existing assets where practical, avoiding unnecessary tables or pipelines, and documenting technical decisions and support requirements.

• Partner with Technology/IT and central teams on data access, infrastructure, security and platform dependencies.

Simplification, Automation & AI

• Identify repetitive, manual or low-value activities and challenge whether they should continue in their current form.

• Apply a simplify-first mindset by removing unnecessary steps and complexity before automating work.

• Design reusable workflows and automation that make recurring analysis faster, more reliable and easier to maintain.

• Explore and responsibly apply AI capabilities to customer analytics, segmentation, Voice-of-Customer analysis, reporting and other relevant business problems.

• Experiment with new technologies, evaluate their usefulness and turn successful experiments into practical capabilities that can benefit the broader organization.

Reporting, Data & Analytics Capabilities

• Develop and maintain trusted semantic models, dashboards, recurring reporting and analytical products using Microsoft Power BI and other appropriate tools.

• Create standardized, reusable data products that reduce repeated manual extracts, recurring reporting and low-value ad hoc requests.

• Help develop Customer 360 and customer-journey views that connect customer behavior across channels and activities.

• Maintain clear documentation of data sources, KPI definitions, transformations, workflow dependencies, validation steps and troubleshooting procedures.

• Assess whether work should be simplified, automated, transferred to self-service or stopped before building a new solution.

Business Partnership & Communication

• Partner with CRM, E-commerce, Retail, Customer Care, Marketing, Finance and technical teams to understand the decision behind a request and translate business needs into practical solutions.

• Proactively communicate status, risks, blockers, dependencies, trade-offs and expected resolution dates so stakeholders are not surprised by gaps or delays.

• Explain technical processes, limitations and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Constructively challenge requests when a simpler, more reusable or higher-value approach is available.

• Share knowledge, documentation and reusable solutions so critical processes do not depend on one person.

Experience & Skills
Required

• Strong SQL skills, including complex transformations, joins, data validation, performance troubleshooting and reusable logic.

• Hands-on Python experience for data processing, automation, integration or analytical applications.

• Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.

• Experience building and supporting data pipelines, automated analytical processes or production workflows.

• Experience working with APIs, JSON and file-based integrations such as SFTP.

• Experience with Microsoft Power BI or a comparable business-intelligence platform, including data modeling and dashboard development.

• Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills, with the ability to independently own an issue through resolution.

• Clear, proactive written and verbal communication across technical and business teams.

• Sound analytical judgment and the ability to connect technical outputs to customer, commercial or operational decisions.

Preferred

• Experience with customer, CRM, retail, E-commerce, and marketing data.

• Experience with customer segmentation, campaign audiences, triggered communications or customer-journey analysis.

• Experience with KNIME or another low-code workflow and orchestration platform.

• Experience with Git or another version-control tool.

• Familiarity with AI-assisted analytical tools and responsible use of customer data.

• Experience creating self-service data products or analytical applications for business users.

What Will Make You Successful

• Ownership. You independently own the technical work and its operational reliability. You raise issues early, explain the impact and drive resolution.

• Curiosity. You ask why, learn unfamiliar tools and business processes quickly, and investigate what does not make sense.

• Pragmatism. You can build sophisticated solutions, but choose the simplest approach that reliably solves the problem and can be maintained.

• Simplification. You reduce unnecessary steps before automating and challenge work that no longer provides enough value to continue.

• Business orientation. Technology is a means, not the outcome. You measure success through adoption, reliability, efficiency, customer experience and commercial value.

• Communication. You provide context, status and risks frequently enough that partners are not surprised.

• Collaboration. You work transparently across teams, document decisions and build solutions that others can understand and support.

Who We Are

Excellence Community Schools (ECS) is a Charter Management Organization (CMO) supporting schools in the Bronx, NY and Stamford, CT. Our programs are based on a proven, nationally recognized model, which originated in our flagship school, the Bronx Charter School for Excellence, a National Blue Ribbon School.

Our Mission and Vision

Our schools prepare young scholars to compete for admission to and succeed in top public, private, and parochial high schools by cultivating their intellectual, artistic, social, emotional, and ethical development. We accomplish this by offering a challenging and rigorous academic curriculum, which at the earliest of grades has an eye towards college preparation. To achieve this, our schools create a supportive and caring environment that consistently holds high expectations for all students. We offer a differentiated, project-based learning environment that seeks to develop high-level analytical and critical-thinking skills in all our students. Our engaging and rigorous approach to educating our scholars is implemented by a collaborative team of teachers.

Who We Need

We are seeking a Data Analyst to support reporting, data quality processes, analytical projects, and data-driven decision making across the organization. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure data accuracy, develop actionable insights, and support operational and strategic initiatives through analysis and reporting. The Data Analyst will also support quantitative analysis and data-informed planning to evaluate program effectiveness, monitor operational performance, and inform strategic decision-making across schools and organizational functions. This may include analyzing trends, assessing outcomes of organizational initiatives, supporting enrollment and operational planning, and supporting academic and operational reporting processes such as report cards and progress monitoring.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with large datasets. This position is well-suited for a professional with strong technical aptitude and an interest in data analytics, reporting, statistical analysis, and operational problem-solving in an education setting.

• Create and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, and visualizations for operational and academic stakeholders.

• Support report card, progress monitoring, enrollment, attendance, assessment, and other school-based reporting processes.

• Conduct analyses to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights that support school and organizational goals.

• Present findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Quantitative Analysis & Strategic Support

• Support analytical projects using quantitative and statistical methods.

• Conduct trend analysis and support forecasting and planning initiatives using historical and operational data.

• Analyze program effectiveness and operational outcomes to support continuous improvement efforts.

• Identify patterns, risk indicators, and opportunities for operational and academic improvement.

Data Quality & Data Management

• Support efforts to improve data accuracy, consistency, reliability, and documentation practices.

• Collaborate with internal teams to support operational and reporting needs across schools and departments.

The AI Governance, Security & Data Analyst is responsible for supporting the organization's secure, compliant, and effective use of artificial intelligence, data, and automation technologies.

Reporting to the Director of AI Programs & Strategy, this role leads day-to-day administration and monitoring of UCP's AI security and governance controls, Power Platform and data solutions, AI-ready data management and system integrations.

**Core Responsibilities**

***AI Governance & Security***

* Lead day-to-day administration and monitoring of AI governance and security controls, including access permissions, audit logs, policy compliance, control effectiveness, and approved system configurations.
* Maintain inventories of approved AI systems, copilots, automations, and AI-enabled applications, including ownership, purpose, approval status, and risk classifications.
* Track, document, investigate, and escalate AI governance, security, and compliance concerns; coordinate remediation activities and maintain supporting documentation and evidence.
* Support AI authorization and access management processes, including user provisioning, MFA/SSO integration, periodic access reviews, and validation that unauthorized access is appropriately restricted.
* Support security, compliance, and risk assessments of AI solutions, vendors, data retention practices, and model-training controls.
* Maintain monitoring, audit, and incident records; perform periodic and event-driven reviews and provide documentation and evidence for audits, assessments, and compliance activities.

***Power Platform & Data***

* Design and maintain data models and Power BI semantic models; build reports, dashboards, and real-time analytics measuring program outcomes.
* Develop, maintain, and support approved automation, reporting, and data solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, and other approved technologies.
* Execute approved de-identification processes and document methods used in coordination with data owners and compliance stakeholders.
* Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to improve data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Provide technical support for approved data integrations, workflows, reporting solutions, and AI-enabled business processes.
* Support the maintenance of AI data inventory by identifying where PHI, PII, and FERPA-protected data are created, stored, processed, or transmitted, and assist with the data portions of AI Project Proposals.
* Develop, support, and enhance PowerApps solutions, incorporating approved AI capabilities where appropriate.

***General***

* Coordinate with the cybersecurity team, IS operations leadership, and program stakeholders; final risk decisions remain with the Director of AI and Cybersecurity Program leadership.
* Contribute technical content to UCP's AI Security and Compliance Training and promote data literacy across the organization.
* Participate in training and stay informed of emerging AI, data, automation, governance, and cybersecurity trends, risks, and best practices.
* Adhere to mandatory abuse reporting laws and HIPAA requirements.

**Qualifications**

* A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred (or equivalent knowledge); Associate Degree with relevant experience considered.
* Two or more years' combined experience across information security/compliance monitoring and data analytics or business intelligence is preferred.
* Security side: working knowledge of security monitoring and audit logs, M365 security/compliance tools (Purview, sensitivity labels), and MFA/SSO and cloud/SaaS data-boundary controls.
* Data side: experience with Power BI (data modeling and DAX); Power Automate, Office Scripts, and the Power Platform ecosystem (PowerApps, Dataverse, SharePoint)
* SQL and Python experience.
* Knowledge of HIPAA (including de-identification — Safe Harbor and Expert Determination), FERPA, the NIST AI RMF, incident response, and vendor/BAA review.
* Understanding of AI-specific risks and of how structured, high-quality data enables responsible AI adoption; healthcare or human-services data a plus. Technical certifications preferred.
* Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and documentation skills.
* Highly motivated and self-directed; able to prioritize and execute in a high-pressure environment.
* Advanced desktop computer skills as defined in the skill matrix. Requires three or more hours per day working on a computer.
* Flexible hours including nights, weekends, and working from home required.
* Some travel required. Must have a valid NYS Driver's license.

**Benefits**

Our work environment provides the opportunity to grow and learn in a fast-paced atmosphere.  We offer competitive benefits and salary to include a low-cost individual health insurance plan, dollar for dollar retirement match (up to 7%), life insurance, voluntary benefits and generous paid time off.

* Comprehensive Health/Dental/Vision
* Direct Deposit
* Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Retirement Plan 403(b)
* Life Insurance
* Voluntary Benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Generous PTO Plans (Sick, Vacation and Employee Leave)
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Service Awards
* Employee Appreciation Events
* Employee Discounts

  
Upstate Caring Partners is the premier provider of direct-care services and programs in Central New York for individuals of all abilities and their families.  If you believe in empowering people, Upstate Caring Partners is an excellent place to start or grow your career.  Please visit our careers website to access the full job description located within the job posting.  upstatecpjobs.org

## **What you’ll be part of**

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we’re the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare “win win” — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

### **About the role:**

We are seeking an exceptional AI-Native Data Analyst to join Garner and drive how data shapes business decisions at scale. You'll be the person the business trusts to turn fuzzy questions into the metrics, dashboards, and deep-dive analyses that decisions actually get made on — owning that work end-to-end.

### **Where you will work:**

This role will be based in our New York City office (in the Financial District). You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

### **What you will do:**

* **Own KPIs and dashboards end-to-end.** Build, maintain, and govern key KPIs and dashboards across business domains, managing the full lifecycle of analytics projects from scoping to delivery.
* **Be a thought partner on measurement.** Partner with stakeholders to define how success is measured across Garner's products and operations.
* **Build scalable data pipelines.** Collaborate with the data engineering team to create maintainable pipelines that power reliable reporting.
* **Develop deep domain expertise.** Build a strong understanding of your analytical domain so you can independently drive meaningful insights.
* **Close reporting gaps.** Identify where coverage is missing and proactively develop new dashboards and insights to fill them.
* **Raise the bar on data practices.** Advocate for best practices in visualization, documentation, metric consistency, and stakeholder communication across teams.
* **Answer high-stakes, ambiguous questions.** Run deep-dive investigations into complex business problems — the kind of analysis leadership uses to make strategic calls.

### **The ideal candidate has:**

* **3+ years** **of experience** in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar data-centric role.
* **Cross-functional translation.** Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into data-driven solutions and to work effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
* **Autonomy and ownership.** Comfortable working independently and owning reporting projects end-to-end.
* **Automation mindset.** Attention to detail with a bias toward automation and scalability over one-off work.
* **AI Nativity.** Comfort with and excitement about building analytics, building dashboards, and validating results by harnessing the power of AI agents.
* **Making data accessible**. A track record of getting stakeholders trustworthy, self-serve access to the information they need. Experience with a BI/visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) helps — but the outcome matters more than the specific tool.
* **Modern data stack.** Hands-on with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud warehouse) and SQL at scale; experience with dbt strongly preferred — you'll partner with Data Management in governed pipelines, not just consume their outputs.
* A desire to be part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.

**Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.**

### **What you'll get here:**

You’ll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you’ll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It’s demanding by design. You’ll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

### **Compensation Transparency:**

The target salary range for this position is $131,000 - $140,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k), Teladoc Health and more.

### **Fraud and Security Notice:**

Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use [getgarner.com](http://getgarner.com/) and [garnerhealth.com](garnerhealth.com) email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement [here](https://www.ic3.gov/Home/ComplaintChoice) and to [candidateprotection@garnerhealth.com](mailto:candidateprotection@getgarner.com).

### **Equal Employment Opportunity:**

Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Garner Health is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at [talent@garnerhealth.com](mailto:talent@getgarner.com).
